title: Act II, Scene I

teacherSummary.text: Polonius sends Reynaldo to Paris to spy on Laertes by spreading small slanders. Ophelia enters frightened: Hamlet came to her closet dishevelled, stared, sighed and left. Polonius concludes Hamlet is mad for love and goes to tell the king.
